skill.name: aimpact-crypto
skill.description: Generates Chinese crypto briefings from configured AIMPACT and MetaEra APIs, ranks items by AI score, and supports optional scheduled delivery.
skill.summary: Create ranked Chinese crypto morning reports, evening reports, hot lists, and curated updates.
skill.author: me-news

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, example links, and Unicode-rich documentation. The skill intentionally retrieves two fixed third-party APIs through curl or web_fetch. Its optional Windows example creates a persistent scheduled task, which requires explicit operator review before use.

remediation.issue: The Windows example creates a persistent scheduled task.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before task creation and document commands for inspecting and removing the task.

remediation.issue: The workflow invokes curl for third-party API retrieval.
remediation.suggestion: Use argument-safe tool calls, enforce HTTPS allowlists, set timeouts, and reject redirects to unapproved hosts.

remediation.issue: Reports and optional deliveries depend on external source content.
remediation.suggestion: Label unverified claims, preserve source links, and confirm the destination before sending any report.

content.value_statement: Crypto news is fragmented and difficult to review quickly. This skill collects configured feeds, ranks relevant items, and formats concise Chinese briefings.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves news from the configured AIMPACT and MetaEra API endpoints.
Generates morning, evening, 24-hour hot, and curated crypto reports.
Filters results by requested time range and crypto relevance.
Deduplicates items by title or identifier and selects up to ten entries.
Sorts entries by API-provided AI scores when available.
Formats Chinese reports by category with summaries, source links, and a trend observation.
limitations: Source quality, accuracy, and availability depend on two external APIs.
AI scores and category labels may be incomplete or inaccurate.
The skill does not provide investment advice or verify every reported claim.
Scheduled delivery requires separately configured OpenClaw tools, credentials, and operating-system tasks.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Analyst Morning Brief
use_cases.description: Collect overnight crypto developments and organize the highest-ranked items into a concise Chinese report.

use_cases.title: Publish an Editorial Hot List
use_cases.description: Review the most influential crypto stories from the last 24 hours with categories and source links.

use_cases.title: Monitor Daily Industry Updates
use_cases.description: Generate scheduled morning and evening summaries for an approved internal messaging channel.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Morning Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate today’s AIMPACT Crypto morning report.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for the standard morning briefing.

prompt_templates.title: Review the 24-Hour Hot List
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the Crypto 24-hour hot list, rank items by available AI score, and include source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Quick review of the highest-ranked recent stories.

prompt_templates.title: Focus an Evening Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate today’s Crypto evening report and prioritize regulation, DeFi, and market-data developments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Category-focused briefing for an informed reader.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Themes Across Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a curated 24-hour Crypto report, remove duplicate stories, group items by category, and summarize the strongest cross-source trend.

output: A dated Chinese morning briefing with up to ten ranked stories.
Each story includes a category, concise summary, and source link.
The report ends with one cross-story trend observation.

output_examples.output: A categorized hot list ordered by available AI scores, with duplicate items removed and original source links preserved.

output_examples.input: Create an evening report focused on regulation.
output_examples.output: A Chinese evening briefing that emphasizes regulatory developments while retaining other high-ranked market stories.

best_practices: Review source links and verify material claims before distributing a report.
Test report generation manually before enabling scheduled delivery.
Confirm the approved destination and timezone for every scheduled channel.
anti_patterns: Do not treat rankings or summaries as investment advice.
Do not add unapproved endpoints or replace failed APIs with unrestricted web searches.
Do not create scheduled tasks or send messages without explicit operator approval.

faq.question: Which reports can this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates morning reports, evening reports, 24-hour hot lists, and curated crypto updates.

faq.question: Which data sources does it use?
faq.answer: It uses configured AIMPACT Crypto and MetaEra API endpoints hosted on agent.me.news.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes third-party news and rankings for research and monitoring.

faq.question: Can it send reports automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, but delivery requires a preconfigured message tool and an operator-approved scheduled task.

faq.question: What happens when an API request fails?
faq.answer: The workflow may retry the same allowlisted URL with web_fetch and should report the failure status.

faq.question: How many stories appear in a report?
faq.answer: The standard workflow selects up to ten relevant, deduplicated items.
